transcript.snippet: Sunday morning is not for rushing. It is a sacred space designed to nourish your soul. Stop dragging the exhaustion of
last week into your clean slate. Breathe in the silence before the world starts demanding your energy. You have been moving so fast trying to prove yourself.
But true power lives in your ability to slow down. Your value is not measured by
your endless to-do list. This morning, you are permitted to just exist. Let the
quietness of this room remind you of who you are. You are the author of your peace, not a servant to the noise.

constantly overachieve to feel worthy. I am perfectly aligned with my own unique
